rca.primary_cause: The turbine is experiencing a high risk of overheating due to excessive generator temperature.
causal_chain: This is causing a high residual generator temperature (residual_generator_temp: 4.3890).
The high generator temperature is likely due to increased power output (power_output: 3.4717) and a high power efficiency ratio (power_efficiency: -0.6311).

recommendation.procedure: Inspect the cooling air filter and replace it if the pressure drop is greater than 50% of the new filter specification. Check the cooling fan rotation and belt tension. Measure the generator current in all three phases to identify any imbalances. Verify that the derating curve is applied at high ambient temperatures. Clean or replace air filters (scheduled every 3–6 months) and inspect the cooling fan belt or fan motor if failed.
safety_warnings: Never hammer the bearing race when removing it.

schedule.recommended_action: Perform a high-priority maintenance procedure on WTG-005 to inspect and replace the cooling air filter, check the cooling fan rotation and belt tension, and measure the generator current in all three phases.

parts.supplier_notes: Ensure expedited shipping for all ordered parts to meet the 3-day deadline.

executive_summary: Turbine WTG-005 has triggered a HIGH risk alert due to excessive generator temperature, posing a significant risk of overheating. This condition is expected to last for approximately 29.7 days if left unaddressed. To mitigate this risk, we recommend performing a high-priority maintenance procedure within the next 3 days to inspect and replace the cooling air filter, check the cooling fan rotation and belt tension, and measure the generator current in all three phases. Prompt action is necessary to prevent potential damage to the turbine and ensure continued safe operation.
